title: Race Condition Playbook Checklist
description: One entry per weakness pattern the invoking AI agent should look for when reviewing code for TOCTOU-shaped file/resource access (plan 024). Scoped to TOCTOU only for v1 (narrowed at this plan's reopening kickoff, 2026-07-25) — not general check-then-act on arbitrary shared state, non-atomic read-modify-write, or missing-lock patterns. Playbook-only, no deterministic scanner: semgrep registry coverage for race conditions/TOCTOU was checked at this plan's original kickoff (2026-07-22) and found close to zero registry-wide, so unlike 007/023/013's hybrids there is no real deterministic coverage worth wrapping. A finding the agent produces from an item here must still conform to finding.schema.json.

ruleId.description: The ruleId the agent must stamp on any finding.schema.json finding it produces from this item — same naming convention as every other sub-skill (e.g. 'race-condition.toctou-file-existence-then-open').

weaknessClass.description: A single value for v1, since scope is TOCTOU-only — kept as an enum (not a hardcoded literal in the description alone) so a future revision widening scope beyond TOCTOU (e.g. adding a 'non-atomic-read-modify-write' class) doesn't need a breaking schema change, just a new enum value.

guidance.description: Concrete instruction to the agent on what to look for in the code — not a restatement of the CWE definition.

evidenceRequirement.description: What counts as sufficient evidence before reporting this as a finding, not a suspicion — same evidentiary-rigor bar 023's checklist already established.

languageNotes.description: Optional per-language/framework idioms to check for. Not required for every item — the core guidance is language-agnostic; this only adds concrete, language-specific things to grep for.

references.description: Same shape as finding.schema.json's references[] — reused directly so an agent-produced finding's references can be copied straight from here.

suggestedSeverity.description: A default suggestion, not a hard rule — TOCTOU impact varies by what the raced resource actually is. The agent may adjust based on context, but must not adjust silently: see confidenceGuidance.

defaultMax.description: Upper bound the agent should self-report for a playbook-derived finding of this item, absent stronger corroboration — deliberately lower than a deterministic detector's typical confidence.
